effect_sizes.name: housekeeping/excess ratio at alpha=0.95 (base protocol)
effect_sizes.method: exact dense computation (degenerate CI: identity, not estimate)

n_justification: 5 alpha levels x 5 refinements x 5 durations, all EXACT dense computations (2x2 joint chains) — no sampling error; the pre-registered predictions P1-P3 are pass/fail against these identities.
notes: P1 excess ~1/K under step refinement; P2 housekeeping zero at alpha=0, monotone in alpha, linear in protocol duration (slope = NESS EPR burn rate) — quasi-static driving is free only for potential games; P3 Hatano-Sasa IFT exact at every alpha including off detailed balance.
